import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-seq0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-dc5eedfe.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    points = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 2]
    by_row = {}
    for r, c in points:
        by_row.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    candidates = [(len(cols), max(cols) - min(cols), r, cols) for r, cols in by_row.items() if len(cols) >= 2]
    _, _, base_row, cols = max(candidates)
    left, right = min(cols), max(cols)
    for c in range(left + 1, right):
        if out[base_row][c] == 0:
            out[base_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        if r == base_row:
            continue
        step = 1 if r < base_row else -1
        for rr in range(r + step, base_row + step, step):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out
'''
